title: Replay protection bypassed on cached-key path
description: inbox.rs:576-584. This is a duplicate/confirmation of smallhold-z3ty.2 from the crypto review perspective. When verify_and_fetch_actor succeeds via the cached key (lines 577-584), it returns early BEFORE the replay detection block at lines 602-616. This means a replayed HTTP POST to the inbox with an identical Date/Digest/Signature will be accepted as long as: (1) the remote actor's key is cached (common case), and (2) the Date is within the ±5 minute freshness window. The attacker need only capture and replay a legitimate signed request. This is an integrity issue: replayed Follow, Like, Announce activities will create duplicate notifications and state mutations. The replay detection hash (actor:date:digest) MUST be checked unconditionally before returning from verify_and_fetch_actor.
close_reason: Duplicate of smallhold-z3ty.2. Confirmed from crypto review — same finding.
